title: Insert snapshot and deltas before the current user message
objective: Replace the current user-then-listing behavior with one unified request path that appends current catalog projection before current user input.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Use the coordinator for Run, RunWithContent, and prepared/retry paths.
Delete or retire the old name/signature announcedSkillStates implementation.
Append snapshot/delta before current user while preserving all older history bytes.
Do not change system blocks, tool schemas, or prompt cache key when catalog revision changes.

After a successful Skill tool result is appended to visible history, validate its SkillExecutionReceipt against the current context epoch and commit content/payload digests to the per-session loaded ledger; never commit failed, cancelled, invisible, or stale-epoch results.
Route every query.go visible-history replacement, including manual ForceCompact, through one context-epoch reset/install helper consumed by post-compact wiring.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Centralize pre-user catalog preparation at the sampling boundary.
Wire current Manager snapshot and cursor updates.
Add ordering and all-entry-path regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: First request order is developer snapshot then current user.
Changed request order is old history then developer delta then current user.
Unchanged request appends only current user.
Existing hook/tool/retry paths keep their ordering guarantees.
A loaded-body ledger entry appears only after its exact execution receipt is visible and remains bound to the current context epoch.
Manual compact cannot leave an announced cursor attached to replaced history.
risks: loop/query.go is already dirty and shared; preserve unrelated goal/tool/presentation changes.
dispatch_prompt: Replace legacy skill listing injection in loop/query.go with the pure catalog coordinator and guarantee catalog-before-user ordering across all request paths.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
